title: attention-screening: framework for protein-ligand interaction prediction on kinases
description: Open-source framework for kinase-ligand bioactivity prediction via attention-based semantic screening over linear sequences (amino acids + SMILES). Implements DT-Kinase (ESM-2 8M + MoLFormer + 2D cross-attention + CNN + hierarchical attention pooling) and a unified evaluation protocol for three published baselines (DrugBAN, GraphBAN, ConPLex). Provides scaffold-split universal partitioning, statistical refinements for paired comparison (deduplication by pair, block bootstrap by protein, consensual threshold rule) and a multi-model committee validated as the optimal operational configuration. Trained model weights and curated datasets are deposited as a separate Zenodo record.
